end.gold: Before Maghrib today: say one “I'm sorry.”

captions: 17:10. One milk, one bread. Six people ahead.
The cashier is new. She scans the same item twice.
You sigh. Loudly. “Can we hurry up?”
Her hands start shaking. Her badge says: “First day.”
You pay. You don't look at her. You leave.
At the bus stop. Rain. Her face won't leave you.
The bus comes. You let it go. You walk back in.
“Sorry about earlier. You're doing fine.” She smiles.

post.caption:
4 minutes in a queue, you lost it. Allah waited years for you. 🤍

The patience He shows us every day is the patience we can give the person in front of us.

“Indeed, Allah is with the patient.” (2:153)

Before Maghrib today: say one “I'm sorry.”
